user.title: Set up medication schedule
user.description: Creates local medication management and the sidebar entry. All data remains in Home Assistant.

record_intake.name: Record intake
record_intake.description: Records a complete or partial medication intake.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: ID of the due intake occurrence.

doses.name: Doses
doses.description: Optional mapping of medication IDs to amounts actually taken.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: ID of the open intake occurrence.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Number of minutes to postpone the reminder.

add_package.name: Add package
add_package.description: Adds a physical package and recalculates the medication stock from all packages.

nickname.name: Nickname
nickname.description: Optional memorable package name; generated automatically when empty.

external_code.name: External code
external_code.description: Optional barcode, QR, or DataMatrix content printed on the package.

record_unplanned_intake.name: Record unplanned intake
record_unplanned_intake.description: Records medication taken outside a schedule and deducts stock using FEFO.

items.name: Medications and doses
items.description: List of medication_id and dose objects.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional free-text note stored with the intake.

postpone_interval.name: Move interval intake to tomorrow
postpone_interval.description: Moves a due interval intake to tomorrow and shifts every following date by the same number of days.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: ID of the due untouched interval intake.

delete_all_data.name: Delete all Medication Reminder data
delete_all_data.description: Permanently deletes all medications, packages, schedules, tickets, and history while keeping the integration installed.

confirmation.name: Confirmation
confirmation.description: Enter DELETE exactly to authorize permanent deletion.

skip_intake.name: Skip intake
skip_intake.description: Marks an open intake as skipped without changing stock.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence ID
occurrence_id.description: ID of the open intake occurrence.

schedule_intake.name: Schedule a one-off intake
schedule_intake.description: Plans a single intake that does not belong to a repeating plan, for example magnesium in the evening after a workout.

items.name: Medications and doses
items.description: List of objects with a dose and either medication_id or medication, which accepts the medication name or its scan code.

scheduled_at.name: Date and time
scheduled_at.description: Absolute point in time for the intake.

time.name: Time
time.description: Clock time for the intake. Without a date it means today, or tomorrow when that time has already passed.

in_minutes.name: In minutes
in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until the intake is due.

title.name: Title
title.description: Heading of the ticket; defaults to the reason.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why this intake was planned, shown in the app, the reminder and the history export.

reference.name: Reference
reference.description: Deduplication key. Calling again with the same reference reschedules the existing open intake instead of adding a second.

notify_services.name: Notification services
notify_services.description: notify.* services used for this intake.

reminder_window_minutes.name: Stop reminding after
reminder_window_minutes.description: Minutes after the due time when reminders stop. 0 keeps reminding until the intake is resolved.

auto_miss_after_minutes.name: Mark as missed after
auto_miss_after_minutes.description: Minutes after which an untouched intake is marked as missed. 0 keeps it open.

cancel_intake.name: Cancel a one-off intake
cancel_intake.description: Removes a planned one-off intake that has not been recorded yet, without writing it to the history.

reference.name: Reference
reference.description: Reference the intake was scheduled with.
